create_StringCache_context_manager: create a StringCache context manager to enable the global string cache for categorical columns
create_StringCache_decorator: use StringCache as a function decorator to enable the global string cache during function execution
enable_string_cache: enable the global string cache so categorical columns share the same underlying physical values
disable_string_cache: disable and clear the global string cache for categorical columns
test_using_string_cache: test whether the global string cache is currently enabled
